description: In front of you on the blue-covered surface are two nested bowls, a light-blue bowl sitting inside an orange bowl, with a large pillow propped up behind them. The left hand stays resting near the center while the right hand reaches to the stacked bowls, grips the top light-blue bowl as a right-hand object, lifts it upward, and moves it to the right to set it down, leaving the orange bowl and another light-blue bowl separated on the surface.
